description: This file defines a command-line interface framework with a Command class and a custom OptionParser, including methods for argument parsing, help display, and execution flow control.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: A base class for command-line commands, handling argument parsing, help display, and execution logic.

classes.name: HelpPrintingOptionParser
classes.description: A custom option parser that enhances error handling and lazy epilog formatting.

methods.name: Command.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a Command instance, setting required arguments and option parser.

methods.name: Command._exit
methods.description: Exits the program with a given status code.

methods.name: Command.set_option_parser
methods.description: Sets and configures the option parser used by the command.

methods.name: Command._add_options_to_parser
methods.description: Adds command options to the option parser.

methods.name: Command._parse_required_arguments
methods.description: Parses argument names into a list of required arguments.

methods.name: Command.name_with_arguments
methods.description: Constructs the command usage string including options and arguments.

methods.name: Command.parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments using the option parser.

methods.name: Command.check_arguments_and_execute
methods.description: Validates arguments and executes the command if valid.

methods.name: Command.standalone_help
methods.description: Generates help text for the command.

methods.name: Command.execute
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to perform command actions.

methods.name: Command.main
methods.description: Main entry point for executing the command, suitable for standalone scripts.

methods.name: HelpPrintingOptionParser.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the custom option parser with optional epilog method.

methods.name: HelpPrintingOptionParser.error
methods.description: Handles parsing errors, displaying usage and error message.

methods.name: HelpPrintingOptionParser.format_epilog
methods.description: Returns the epilog string, computed lazily if a method is provided.
